title: Dinner Party Held By Kachu Power Company

page_data.en:
FM. 2
G. 55M-1-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. I. Special Branch Station,
REPORT

File No.
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. R. D. 8790
Date
Date October 21, 1938.

Subject Dinner party held by Kachu Power Company.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by W Logan A/M

With reference to the attached. I have to state
that the dinner party of officials of the Kachu Power
Company, a Japanese concern, was held at the An Hwa Lau
Restaurant on Foochow Road between 6.30 p.m. and 9.10 p.m.,
October 20, having been attended by twenty Japanese and
one Chinese. C.D.S.I. Pan Lien Pih, J.D.S. 156 and
D.S. Kamashita carried out observation duty in and outside
the restaurant during the above period, but no untoward
incident occurred.

Two J.P.Cs. of Central Station and three F.Ss.,
one S.P.C., two C. .Ss. and two Chinese detectives of
Louza Station were also detailed to the restaurant for
duty during the above period.

N. Kamashita
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

DC Davis
Information
of Mr Robertson
DC (SB)

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER * 22 OCT 1938 (DIVISIONS)）

FILE
26R. 23/10.

F. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别情报股分站，
报告

档案号
特别情报股登记处
编号 S. R. D. 8790
日期
日期 1938年10月21日。

事由 嘉秋电力公司举行的晚宴。

呈报人 D. S. Kamashita 转呈人 W Logan A/M

关于附件内容。兹陈述如下：
日商嘉秋电力公司（Kachu Power Company）官员的晚宴于10月20日下午6时30分至9时10分在福州路安华楼（An Hwa Lau）餐厅举行，出席者包括二十名日本人和一名中国人。特别情报股中国籍警探潘连璧（Pan Lien Pih）、日本籍警探第156号以及 D. S. Kamashita 在上述时段于餐厅内外执行监视任务，未发生任何意外事件。

中央巡捕房的两名日本巡捕（J.P.Cs.）以及三名外国巡捕（F.Ss.）、一名特别巡捕（S.P.C.）、两名中国巡捕（C. .Ss.）和老闸捕房的两名中国侦探亦被派往该餐厅在上述时段执勤。

N. Kamashita
侦探长（D. S.）

副督察长（特别股）。

DC Davis
罗伯逊先生知悉
副督察长（特别股）

（印：副总监 * 1938年10月22日（各部门））

归档
26R. 10月23日。

F. A. 致 副督察长（特别股）
